description: Band gap, DOS/PDOS, Bader charge analysis

band_gaps.method: QE7.4.1 (PBE), USPP/RRKJUS, 52/520 Ry, k=6x6x6 SCF on k=4x4x4-relaxed V0, dos.x + projwfc.x, MV smearing. Gap from low-DOS run straddling EF (DOS<0.5).
band_gaps.kmesh_correction_note: PROPER k=6x6x6. The earlier gap=1.50 was a k=2x2x1 artifact (k×L=10 Å, 4x too sparse). Correct k-mesh raised gap 1.50 -> 1.76 (+0.26 eV). Geometry barely changed (RMS 0.003 Å between k221 and k444 relax) — the k-mesh contamination was electronic (gap), not geometric.

band_gaps.method: Same as comp1_v3 (6x6x3, k×L=42 Å, converged). Re-analyzed 2026-06-04 with plot_dos.py; matches original 2026-06-01 (gap 1.80 -> 1.82, within DeltaE grid).

comparison_comp1_v3_vs_modelc_v3._CORRECTION: Earlier delta_gap=-0.32 was a k-MESH ARTIFACT (comp1 ran at k=2x2x1, gap 1.50). With proper k (comp1 6x6x6, modelc 6x6x3, both converged), comp1=1.76 ≈ modelc=1.82, Δ only -0.06 eV.
comparison_comp1_v3_vs_modelc_v3.interpretation: With consistent converged k-meshes, LPSCl and LPSCl1.6 have ESSENTIALLY THE SAME PBE gap (~1.8 eV). The band gap is NOT sensitive to Cl content / Li-vacancy disorder. Orbital character is identical in both (VBM S 3p ~91%, CBM S 3p ~42% + P 3s ~25% + Li 2p ~14%). The earlier apparent 0.32 eV narrowing of comp1 was purely numerical (sparse k).
comparison_comp1_v3_vs_modelc_v3.EF_note: comp1 EF=2.821 (in gap, clean insulator). modelc EF=2.445 — modelc has Li-vacancy-related states; its defect-band analysis (db bonds/structural) stands as a real feature of the disordered Li-deficient structure.
comparison_comp1_v3_vs_modelc_v3.absolute_vs_literature: Both ~1.76-1.82 eV with USPP-PBE + DOS-threshold method; literature PBE for Li6PS5Cl is ~2.15-2.45 (PAW/band-structure). The ~0.3-0.4 eV offset is method/pseudo + DOS-threshold underestimate; consistent for both systems so the comp1-vs-modelc comparison is valid.
comparison_comp1_v3_vs_modelc_v3.structural_difference_real: The genuine comp1-vs-modelc difference is STRUCTURAL not electronic: comp1 (LPSCl) is ordered (all Cl on 4a, single Li environment); modelc (LPSCl1.6) is disordered (Cl on 4a+4d anti-sites, Li vacancies). See bonds.json / structural_analysis.

trends.Br_effect: Br 4p contributes to VBM -> slight gap reduction
trends.PS4_framework: Invariant across compositions (P-S covalent bonds unchanged)
trends.notes: Mechanical property changes are ionic in origin, not covalent.

bader.Br_polarizability: Higher -> less charge transfer -> weaker bonds
bader.rhombo_issue: FFT grid problem in rhombo cells -> use pp.x plot_num=21 (all-electron)

bader_full_matrix.method: Bader (Henkelman) on QE pp.x charge density (plot_num=0)

Cl_more_ionic_than_Br_pct.anneal_effect: comp2 v1->v2: Cl/Br gap narrowed 5.9% -> 2.1% (Br ordering improved by anneal)

trends_quantitative.comp3_anomaly: |q(Br)|=0.915 > |q(Cl)|=0.903 (site disorder effect, expected to normalize on anneal)
trends_quantitative.comp4_S_anomaly: |q(S)|=1.551 vs -1.7 to -1.85 in others (most-mixed Br/Cl environment)

comp2_v2_P_anomaly_NEW.vs_comp1_v2: +0.207 e (Br doping STRENGTHENS PS4 covalent backbone)
comp2_v2_P_anomaly_NEW.vs_modelC_v2: +0.553 e (Br + vacancy reverse effects on P)
comp2_v2_P_anomaly_NEW.interpretation: Br has DUAL effect on PS4: (1) ionic side - Cl |q| weakens (charge competition), (2) covalent side - P |q| strengthens (lattice expansion + Br polarizability changes local Madelung field). Net mechanical change is partial cancellation (B0 only 0.4 GPa down comp2 vs comp1).

P_three_anchor_separation.comparison_to_comp3_5_v1: comp3-5 v1 P not directly measured (~+4.4 estimated from PS4 invariance)

cross_family_wad_paradox.implication: Wad enhancement in Li5.4 NOT explained by single-atom Bader charges. Must be collective/surface vacancy mechanism (under-coordinated Li at SE-NCM interface forming 'chemical anchor' bonds beyond bulk Bader description).
cross_family_wad_paradox.supports_paper_draft_narrative: vacancy-mediated interfacial anchoring (paper draft v1 confirmed by 3000K control experiment)

elf_comparison_v3._method: ONCV NC pseudo, ecutwfc 80 / ecutrho 320 Ry, pp.x plot_num=8 -> V0_ELF.cube; metrics sampled directly from cube (min-image, Bohr).
elf_comparison_v3._figures: ELF_{comp1,modelC}_{Pz,xy_mid,iso}.png in the cube dirs (slice + 3D iso 0.85). plot tools: tools/modelc_v3/plot_elf_{slice,3d_iso}.py (--label).

P_S_bridge_ELF.definition: ELF at P-S bond midpoint (covalency probe; nuclei avoided)
P_S_bridge_ELF.note: ~0.94-0.95 both -> strong covalent P-S; IDENTICAL within noise (d=0.002) -> PS4 framework covalency UNCHANGED by Cl-enrichment/vacancy. Consistent with ICOHP(P-S) -5.94 vs -6.0.

Li_basin_min_ELF.definition: minimum ELF along Li->nearest-anion line (ionic depletion basin floor; midpoint/at-nucleus sampling fail -> core/anion-shell artifacts)
Li_basin_min_ELF.note: ~0.07 both, very low -> Li+ ionic (valence donated, no covalent bridge). modelc slightly LOWER (0.065; single-min 0.042) = marginally more depleted/ionic Li, the ELF signature of the disordered vacancy-rich Li sublattice.

elf_comparison_v3.interpretation: ELF closes the bond->Bader->COHP->ELF chain: covalent P-S (0.94) vs ionic Li (0.07) = ~13x contrast. The covalent PS4 backbone is preserved across BOTH systems (d ELF ~0.002); the only ELF difference from LPSCl1.6's Cl-enrichment+vacancy is a slightly deeper Li depletion basin (disorder). => structural / Li-sublattice difference, NOT framework-electronic. Same conclusion as bond-length (2.07/2.06), Bader PS4 (-2.8/-2.6), ICOHP (-5.9/-6.0).
